import pytest

def test_reverse_words_basic():
    """Happy path: simple two-word string."""
    assert reverse_words("hello world") == "world hello"


def test_reverse_words_multiple_words():
    """Happy path: more than two words."""
    assert reverse_words("the quick brown fox") == "fox brown quick the"


def test_reverse_words_single_word():
    """Edge case: single word."""
    assert reverse_words("hello") == "hello"


def test_reverse_words_empty_string():
    """Edge case: empty input."""
    assert reverse_words("") == ""


def test_reverse_words_only_whitespace():
    """Edge case: input contains only spaces."""
    assert reverse_words("   ") == ""


def test_reverse_words_multiple_spaces():
    """Edge case: multiple spaces between words."""
    assert reverse_words("hello   world") == "world hello"


def test_reverse_words_leading_trailing_spaces():
    """Edge case: leading and trailing spaces."""
    assert reverse_words("  hello world  ") == "world hello"


def test_reverse_words_tabs_and_newlines():
    """Edge case: mixed whitespace characters (tabs, newlines)."""
    assert reverse_words("hello\tworld\nfoo") == "foo world hello"


def test_reverse_words_punctuation():
    """Edge case: words containing punctuation."""
    assert reverse_words("hello, world!") == "world! hello,"


def test_reverse_words_unicode():
    """Edge case: Unicode characters."""
    assert reverse_words("café au lait") == "lait au café"


def test_reverse_words_non_string_int():
    """Error case: non-string input (integer) should raise AttributeError."""
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        reverse_words(123)


def test_reverse_words_non_string_none():
    """Error case: non-string input (None) should raise AttributeError."""
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        reverse_words(None)
